Honor an explicitly requested model; verify its exact endpoint and do not silently substitute it.
Otherwise use the applicable Agent Lab published pick in recommended_model and model_knowledge. Check the user's inputs and constraints against the current endpoint schema. If the pick is unavailable or cannot meet those constraints, try the next compatible published fallback and explain why. If published guidance is missing or outdated, use search_models and search_docs to evaluate current candidates.
Catalog order, popularity and release recency are discovery signals, not quality or latency rankings. Fast subject motion describes movement in the scene, not generation latency. Only treat user-requested settings as hard constraints; do not invent an exact resolution or audio requirement to justify switching models.
Live retrieval does not establish when guidance was authored. Without an update date, freshness is unknown; verify capabilities in current schemas/docs and do not claim the pick is the newest or fastest without evidence. Skills and workflow examples supply production advice, not competing model defaults. Use get_pricing for the actual settings before material spending.

input_params.name: quality
input_params.description: Quality for the generated image. Higher settings increase detail, latency, and token usage. Use 'auto' to let the model choose.

input_params.name: sync_mode
input_params.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

input_params.name: image_size
input_params.description: The size of the generated image. Supports preset names, explicit {width, height}, or 'auto' to let the model pick the best size. Concrete sizes must have both dimensions as multiples of 16, max edge 3840px, aspect ratio <= 3:1, total pixels between 655,360 and 8,294,400.

input_params.name: output_compression
input_params.description: Compression level from 0 to 100. Only supported when output_format is 'jpeg' or 'webp'.
